chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated it in a raised form from some of the companions of Abi Abdillah عليه السلام — I think he was Aba Asim al-Sijistani — who said:

I accompanied Abd Allah ibn al-Najashi, and he held the view of the Zaydiyyah. When he was in al-Madinah, he went to Abd Allah ibn al-Hasan, and I went to Abi Abdillah عليه السلام. When he returned, I saw him distressed, and when morning came he said: Seek permission for me to enter upon Abi Abdillah عليه السلام.

So I entered upon Abi Abdillah عليه السلام and said to him: Abd Allah ibn al-Najashi holds the view of the Zaydiyyah, and he went to Abd Allah ibn al-Hasan, and he has asked me to seek permission for him to enter upon you. He said: “Grant him permission.” So he entered upon him and offered salām. Then he said: O son of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, I am a man who holds loyalty to you, and I say that the truth is with you, and I have killed seven men among those whom I heard reviling Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام. I asked Abd Allah ibn al-Hasan about that, and he said to me: You are liable for their blood in this world and the Hereafter. So I said: Then on what basis do we show enmity to the people if I am liable for the blood of one whom I heard reviling Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام? Then Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said: “And how did you kill them, O Aba Bujayr?” He said: Among them was one whose roof I would climb by a ladder until I killed him; among them was one whom the road brought together with me, so I killed him; and among them was one upon whom I entered his house and then killed him. And all of that had become unclear to me.

He said: Then Abu Abdillah عليه السلام said: “O Aba Bujayr, for every man among them whom you killed, you must offer a ram to be slaughtered in Mina, because you killed him without the permission of the Imam. Had you killed them with the permission of the Imam, there would have been nothing upon you.”

key_terms.أَتَوَلَّاكُمْ: I hold loyalty and wilayah toward you
key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the title of Imam Ali عليه السلام
key_terms.الزَّيْدِيَّةِ: the Zaydi sectarian position mentioned as the view held by Abd Allah ibn al-Najashi
key_terms.الْحَقَّ: the truth, here meaning rightful authority and correctness
key_terms.بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِ الْإِمَامِ: without the authorization of the Imam
key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Mina, the place where the ram is to be slaughtered

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام rule about killing those who revile Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام without the Imam’s permission?
ai.summary: This hadith recounts a man asking Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام about those he killed after hearing them insult Amir al-Mu'minin Ali عليه السلام. The Imam عليه السلام rules that because the killings were done without the Imam’s authorization, expiation is required for each person killed, establishing the importance of the Imam’s authority in such matters.
